candidates.change_summary: Change return value from true to false.
Delete the require for _tos.length > 0, allowing empty _tos arrays and changing the revert behavior but not the return value on success.
Replace the return value true with false so that the call's return differs from the original after successful execution.
Replace the for loop bound _tos.length with _tos.length-1 so the last element is not processed, which can change the return value if the last call would have failed and reverted.
Replace the require(_s) with require(!_s) so that successful subcalls revert and failed subcalls succeed, altering the revert/success outcome.
